items.title: What is TinyToolFlare?
items.description: TinyToolFlare is a free online toolbox for images, formatters, generators, calculators, and everyday utilities. You can open a tool page and use it directly in your browser.

items.title: Do I need to install anything?
items.description: No. TinyToolFlare tools run online, so you can use them from a browser without installing extra software.

items.title: Which tools are available?
items.description: TinyToolFlare includes image compression, images to PDF, PDF to images, photo location removal, JSON and XML formatters, password and UUID generators, BMI calculator, raised bed soil calculator, laundry symbol decoder, and wake window calculator.

items.title: Is TinyToolFlare free?
items.description: Yes. The public tools are designed to be free to use for everyday tasks.

items.title: Can I use it on mobile?
items.description: Yes. The site is designed to work on modern desktop and mobile browsers.

items.title: Which page should I bookmark?
items.description: Bookmark the homepage for the full toolbox, or bookmark a specific tool page if you use one utility often.
